content.text: Aries (March 21 – April 20)The Moon’s in your sign. You’re awake, alert and ready to speak your truth. Surprises, quick decisions and bold moves suit you today. Someone or something shakes up your routine, but you’re ready to come up with a back up plan. In fact, yours is the sign that can rise to challenges now. Taurus (April 21 – May 21)You feel a pull between staying comfortable and stirring things up. The stars shake your calm, but know that this will uncover what’s been quietly stuck. A small risk will free more than you expect. Be ready to live life out loud. Want to know if it’s worth the gamble? Gemini (May 22 – June 21)Words, thoughts and messages speed by like sparks. Even a throwaway text is going to resonate deeper than you think. Watch what you say to those you want to get back on track with, please, as the winds of the day carry weight to words spoken. Your normally soft comfort-zone gets challenged. The cosmic energy prods you as something overlooked demands attention. Don’t let a home detail, a relationship niggle or a petty grudge stop you from tying up what you left undone before the weekend. Give it light. Leo (July 24 – August 23)Fire meets finesse today. You’re alive with ideas, but you’re also being influenced by those who are more concerned with how things look to others, rather than the long term plan that you want to focus on. Going back to figures already done can save you a small fortune. Virgo (August 24 – September 23)Your attention to detail becomes your secret strength. In fact, it’s what’s going to get you ahead of the competition sooner than you thought. Things you agree to learn from this month onwards will be the making of you, so don’t let others take you away from what you know is tailor made for you. Libra (September 24 – October 23)Balance is testing you, between heart and head, comfort and action, give and take. The stirring Moon energy feels like it’s tipping the scales. Instead of avoiding the wobble, feel it, then choose what steadies you, my friend. Want clarity on what that choice should be? Scorpio (October 24 – November 22)A feeling of intensity lurks under today’s quicksilver energy. Secrets, feelings, or old wounds surface, uninvited but unavoidable. Handling it with calm promises to give you more power than exploding. You are the one who can’t steady the ship. Sagittarius (November 23 – December 21)Adventure and impulse feel close. But today’s energy favours quick instincts over careful plans, and that can be brilliant but can also leave you feeling out of your comfort zone. Feel the fear and do it anyway. Decisions made at this time, I see, can be the making of you. Capricorn (December 22 – January 20)Today nudges you to shake up your routine, but gently please, my friend. A simple change at work, in finances, or in schedule will lighten the load more than a big overhaul. Small slack, thoughtful pivot: that’s your secret move. Aquarius (January 21 – February 19)You’re restless, Aquarius, not for drama, but for something real. The Moon pushes you toward clarity, not clutter. You question what you’ve accepted for comfort’s sake. Honest eyes today see true shapes. Pisces (February 20 – March 20)Mars in Aries sextiles to Pluto in Aquarius and you work well as a team now, but it is also your very individual way of thinking that can help you to bring out the best in others. Your dreams are vivid but also tinged with impatience, so wait for the clarity before you act.
